title: StagePerformanceStandaloneInsight
description: Standalone performance insights for a specific stage.

slotContention.description: Output only. True if the stage has a slot contention issue.

insufficientShuffleQuota.description: Output only. True if the stage has insufficient shuffle quota.

biEngineReasons.description: Output only. If present, the stage had the following reasons for being disqualified from BI Engine execution.

highCardinalityJoins.description: Output only. High cardinality joins in the stage.

stageId.description: Output only. The stage id that the insight mapped to.
